newsitem.title: USA: Getty Petroleum names DeLaurentis president.
newsitem.headline: Getty Petroleum names DeLaurentis president.

text.p: Getty Petroleum Marketing Inc said Monday it had named Vincent DeLaurentis as president of the company.
DeLaurentis, former vice president and general manager of Sunoco's Northeast Marketing Region, will assume his duties on August 4, it said in a statement.
The gasoline and heating oil marketing company said its chairman and chief executive officer, Leo Liebowitz, was giving up the additional title of president.

"Mr. Liebowitz will also continue in his present capacities as chairman, president, and chief executive officer of Getty Realty Corp," it said. The company leases gasoline service station properties and oil terminals to Getty Petroleum Marketing.
In March 1997, Getty Petroleum Marketing Inc was spun off to the stockholders of Getty Petroleum Corp, which has changed its name to Getty Realty Corp.
